title: Add rollout ring projection prototype
purpose: Prototype how rollout rings would be projected in TUI without enabling remote rollout execution.
scope: Define ring labels such as local, canary, staging and production as projection-only concepts.
Render node count, gate status and rollback readiness using fixture data.
Show preview-only status and disabled execution commands.
Document required future authority before real rollout.
Add snapshot tests for ring projection.
acceptance_criteria: Rollout ring view is clearly marked preview-only.
No remote rollout command is executable.
Rollback readiness and blockers are visible.
failure_modes: Preview state is confused with real fleet state.
